Now I need to write a t task. Since I need to compute Perrin numbers and sum them, I'll use a loop. I need to track the last three Perrin values and accumulate the sum.

I'll use a spec fun to define the Perrin number and the sum, so the ensures can reference them.

```t
t 1
gate loops
task cal_sum(n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 0
  ensures r == perrin_sum(n)
spec fun perrin(k: int): int
  decreases k
= if k == 0 then 3 else if k == 1 then 0 else if k == 2 then 2 else perrin(k - 2) + perrin(k - 3)
spec fun perrin_sum(k: int): int
  decreases k
= if k < 0 then 0 else perrin(k) + perrin_sum(k - 1)
{
  r := 0;
  var i: int := 0;
  var a: int := 3;
  var b: int := 0;
  var c: int := 2;
  while i <= n
    invariant i >= 0 and i <= n
    invariant r == perrin_sum(i - 1)
    invariant i == 0 ==> a == 3 and b == 0 and c == 2
    invariant i >= 1 ==> a == perrin(i - 1) and b == perrin(i - 2) and c == perrin(i - 3)
    decreases n - i + 1
  {
    r := r + a;
    var d: int := b + c;
    c := b;
    b := a;
    a := d;
    i := i + 1;
  }
}
```
